title: Dyker Heights Brooklyn Christmas Lights Tour
description: New York City visitors typically embrace the Christmas spirit by visiting Rockefeller Center, and viewing the famous department store window displays. But for a truly local twist on the holiday tradition, don't miss this Christmas lights tour to Brooklyn, where you can see the decked out homes in Dyker Heights and Bay Ridge. With easy travel, over-the-top decorations, and Manhattan skyline views, this tour is sure to put you in a festive mood.

reviews.usertext: We took this tour at the beginning of December which meant that although not all of the houses were decorated the streets were much quieter than later on in the month. The bus journey was very comfortable and we stopped at 2 locations to see the lights. Our guide was great and it was easy to keep track of where we were going. The lights are amazing and the experience was even better as it was snowing the whole way through! The last stop was Dumbo although by this time it was pretty windy and we were all soaked through because of the snow so no-one wanted to hang about for long. I imagine in better weather this would be a fabulous final stop. I'm glad we went when it was quiet as I don't think it would have been as enjoyable at peak times.

While on a business trip to NYC, I took this evening tour one night about a week before Christmas. It absolutely helped me escape the work day and get into the holiday spirit! This was a wonderful way to see another side of NYC. The journey to boroughs outside Manhattan gave me a better idea of what life is like for local people. My tour guide and driver were friendly, punctual, and full of interesting information about the communities we visited. The stop at the East River provided a beautiful view of the City. This trip is highly recommended for anyone who loves holiday lights and wants to see how local New Yorkers decorate their homes.

Wow, the Christmas lights here are mind blowing! I had a real sense of nostalgia walking around looking at the Christmas lights, reminded me of when I was a kid and my parents would drive me around the local estates to see the lights! This really does get you into the festive spirit. The tour guide was amazing and and very knowledgeable! I struggled to hear all he was saying on the bus but it was still a l fantastic tour. You could spend a lot longer walking around but I think the temperatures meant we definitely had enough time. The extra little stop near the Brooklyn Bridge was also a wonderful bonus and I got some fabulous pictures of THAT skyline. Definitely recommend doing a tour rather than trying to get around alone.

I rated this poor due to COVID protocols not being enforced. With them losing last year due to COVID, the recent spike in COVID claims and the new Omicron variant, I would think they would have been overly cautious to protect their guests. No one had their vaccination status checked. Everywhere else we went checked vaccination status. They didn't require masks on the bus. The bus was extremely hot, and one guest left before the trip started because of the heat. They also played the Christmas music way too loudly, but it was a nice touch.

Dyker Heights was very interesting to visit and there were many elaborate displays. I would only do this again using a private transportation option.

The deli stop had great hot chocolate and pizza.

If you want to see the Christmas lights in Dyker Heights this the way to do it. Bus leaves from mid-town Manhattan. Your guide had good info, but didn’t talk our ears off. Plenty of time at the stops. All around great tour.
Wonderful tour for the whole family. We did this Christmas eve. It's like nothing we've seen before. Worth paying for. Great stop off on the way back under Brooklyn bridge.

Very long tour, over 4 hours! The houses were decorated nicely, but Not worth the time and $. At one point, driver went in circles after realizing crossing Manhattan bridge rather than Brooklyn bridge was necessary. Tour guide had us all sleepy.

We had a good time. Allen was a great tour guide and told some very interesting stories. The lights were pretty but in all honesty there are many neighborhoods in the Houston area that have similar and some have much better light displays.

I had heard about Dyker Heights for many years. People raved about it. We decided to check it out. I am so glad we did. It is a little long, but the tour guide was amazing and knowledgeable. We had ample time to view all the homes in Brooklyn. There was some waiting with slower people in our group. The sights were breathtaking. The houses are over the top. The stop at the Brooklyn Bridge, while nice, not really necessary. But, overall, if you want to see the most decorated homes for Christmas, then do this. It will fill you with the holiday spirit. Amazing!

We really enjoyed this trip. The coach picks you up down the side of The Row Hotel on *8th Avenue. Its then approx. a 1 Hour drive to Brooklyn , you go past Ground Zero /One World Observatory. The tour guide gives a good interesting commentary on what you can see on the way and what to expect when you get there. There are 2 Stops to view the decorated houses. the first one just one street the bus drops you of one end and picks you up the other, the Blue house has really gone to town and looks fantastic. The second stop is Dyker Heights. Coach drops you of as it can be busy in this area, Then you walk around a large fairly affluent block of houses all really fantastically decorated with lights. One note for this trip is that if you have trouble walking this may not be for you as it is a walking trip mainly with a guide . Then its back to the bus for some great views of Manhatten from Brooklyn ,with a great photo opp just before crossing back over the River. We took the 6pm trip and got back around 9.30 due to heavy traffic, the 4pm according to the guide is quicker due to less traffic.

Dyker Heights is a residential area in Brooklyn accessible by pre booking the bus tour with Tripadvisor, the Christmas lights are amazing, every house (mansion) million pound homes are decorated very tastefully, if you are a lover of everything Christmas you would love this tour, on the return journey there is a stop off at Brooklyn Bridge for photos & Hot Chocolate. Thoroughly recommended.

Oh we went on this tour. We had 3 stops. I wasn’t expecting 3 stops but it was awesome at each. Lots of walking and prepare for the weather. Met some great people from all over the world. Steve was our tour guide. He did a great job. We didn’t lose anyone and everyone had a great time. We ended up at the ice cream shop under the Brooklyn Bridge. Beautiful pics and even though it was cold —- it was yummy!!!

This is a go see!

Nice way to get into the Christmas spirit! Bus trip from Manhattan over and back was beneficial to see parts of the city at night. Neighborhood lighting was off the charts! Tour guide and bus driver did a great job.

Tour 22.12.19 5pm. Tour guide very informative and friendly. Sorry forget name ☹️ Bus driver did amazing job navigating roads and crowds too! Sights amazing although as expected every crowded. Recommend this tour. Well organised

We brought our grandchildren and they enjoyed it as well as us.
The tour guide was very informative just awesome! Wish I remembered his name, he had an accent.
The neighborhood was very festive. Well worth every penny

It's tacky and naff but a must do at Christmas in NYC. Unfortunately for us it was cold and raining during our visit but we still had fun. Some of the decs are so over the top it's like going to Essex, but some of them are proper works of art. It reminded us of National Lampoons Christmas Vacation. The only thing missing was the Griswolds. You could imagine Chevy Chase at the top of a ladder with a stapler. You should definitely put this at the top of you list of things to do if you are visiting NYC in December. Thoroughly recommend.
These lights are out of this world, the cost and effort these people go to is unbelievable. If you love Christmas and are in NYC at that time of the year it's well worth the money.
Alan was great guide pointing out interesting places while enroute to and from the light areas. the bus was clean and confortable with large windows giving good views.

I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting for the Christmas period. What are our guide Alan didn't know about New York, wasnt worth knowing! He did a brill job of giving us information and making sure we didn't get lost. The lights were fantastic and we took some great photos of Brooklyn Bridge at night. 10 out of 10.

I have lived in NY all my life and never new this trip existed until a few weeks ago, well i must say it was an unbelievable experience to see all of the homes done up 100x on the Christmas lights. It was a very well organized tour in part I think to our great your guide Allan, the amount of time in each neighborhood was sufficient and very well described and narrated by him. A special bonus is all the commentary he provides on the way from Manhattan to Brooklyn and back, that was a real surprise to learn about all the other factors of our great city! I was not expecting it and I have to say it was amazing on all the knowledge Allan has, a life long NY'er as well.
I definitely recommend this tour company for this trip!

Only do this tour if you really want to see the Christmas lights in Dyker Heights. The bus ride is long and you will sit in traffic. Be aware you only spend about an hour of the 3-1/2 hours off of the bus. That being said, the lights are amazing!

My mother & I went on this tour last night & thoroughly enjoyed it. The guide, Allan, was brilliant & very funny. His knowledge was amazing & we found it very interesting. We started off stopping at Bayridge to see the houses decorated & got out to walk around. One house spent $75,000 on decorations & $9,000 to a decorating company to have them placed & maintained! Then we moved to Dyker Heights to walk around the houses again, Lucy’s House is unbelievable. Then we stopped at Brooklyn Bridge & went to the Ice Cream factory. Definitely worth the money & Allan was a fantastic guide.

Guided tour versus on your own. I struggled choosing to tour vs planning on my own. The plus of the guided tour was the comfort of the ride to and from as well as the tidbits of NYC information provided along the way. You spend a good amount of time on the bus getting to and from. When we did stop it felt rushed to get through the lights and you can't venture off the path. That is the downside as you might just see the one display you want to check out but cant because you have to stay on tour. I actually liked Bay Ridge better thank Dyker Heights. The lights were just as good and much less crowded. Dyker Heights were so crowded you felt like you were in times square. It actually made it a little less enjoyable. Overall I think it is a must do and the guided tour is the best choice for the first timer. Just don't be that person who goes off the path and get lost in Dyker Heights. You would think it couldn't happen but it does. We had to wait 20 minutes for 4 people to make it back. How rude and inconsiderate. In my opinion the tour guide should have left them.

Super fun and a great way to see NYC and Brooklyn. The homes and the lights are amazing. So much fun to see how crazy people go with Xmas lights.
I only wish they had a pizza stop!

This trip is a must for anyone who loves Christmas lights and wants to experience neighbourhoods outside of Manhattan island. The tour guide was amazing and very knowledgeable about the area. The best part has to be the last stop in DUMBO where you get an amazing view of the Manhattan skyline at night. Be prepared for the trip to last 3-4 hours.

We booked this tour before coming to New York and wasn’t sure what to expect, the bus ride took us to Brooklyn and our guide was informative and charming. We were blown away by the decorated houses, some were so classy and elegant whilst others were just beyond words, whilst off the bus our guide ensured we saw the best decorated properties and using an umbrella and a decorated hat meant we didn’t get too lost in the crowds as it was quoted busy on Christmas Eve. On the way back we stopped alongside the Brooklyn Bridge to see the Manhattan skyline, I would thoroughly recommend the tour run by Tour America.
Loved this tour! Highly recommended, exactly what we were looking for. Tour guide was informative and helpful with restaurant recommendations, etc. Definitely a must-see!

We were very unlucky. It was pouring with rain and it was very early in December so not all the houses were switched on. For my wife and I this did spoil our trip. I would recommend that you go but make sure it is after the first week in December. Unfortunately there is little you can do about the rain. It would have been brilliant if we had not got soaking wet walking around.
The guide however was superb giving some excellent and very interesting commentary throughout the trip. The highlight for us personally was the stop off on the way back for a photo opportunity at the Brooklyn Bridge. We got a cracker

Just want to say we had an amazing time on our tour. We booked with Tour America and would highly recommend. Our tour guide was fantastic, I’m not sure how to spell his name but I do know he was from Uruguay. The driver was also brilliant, I take my hat off to him ; how he negotiated the roads and other drivers was 10/10
.We set off from Manhattan at 5pm and crossed over to Brooklyn and made a short stop in Bayside. Then we went to Dyker Heights and saw some of the most amazing/outrageously decorated homes. Pictures do not do it justice ! We were there about 45 minutes which was plenty of time.
We got back on the coach and set off back and made a short stop at the Fulton ferry to enable anybody who wanted to take photos of the Manhattan skyline.
We crossed back over to Manhattan via Manhattan bridge giving great views of Brooklyn Bridge to your left.
We finished the tour on 42nd street.
I would not hesitate booking with this company in the future and anybody reading this I would say go for it you will thoroughly enjoy the experience.
Great trip, well organised. Dumbo area in the night fantastic as well. Only negative trip was that it was a bit pricey .
The displays are fabulous. Bus was comfortable but took over an hour to get to Brooklyn. We took the 6pm bus which was caught in the rush hour traffic. The host was very knowledgable and witty

Although it was pouring down rain wE still had a great time seeing all the over the top decorated homes. So much time and money was put into decorating these homes. Our tour guide added to the Christmas feeling by playing Christmas music in the way back to Manhattan.
I loved the houses our tour guide was informative. Too long of a bus ride we could’ve skipped going under the Brooklyn bridge. However beautiful the skyline was the ride there was way too long.

Most beautiful decorations for an area, that brings on the Holidays. Easy to enjoy in one or two evenings. Worth the
trip if you are near the City for the Holidays!

Great night trip. The guide was good. The trip made us feel very Christmassy and a must when in NY. However as we did it on 23rd December it was so so busy which did spoil it a little. The last stop was amazing fir a photo opportunity looking back over the city.
A great addition to any Christmas visit to nyc! The people of Brooklyn really know how to decorate their homes for Christmas! If you like viewing Christmas lights, this tour is for you!

We had an excellent Christmas Eve seeing the lights. Eduardo and Eno were great and Eduardo was very knowledgeable with lots of information. Loved seeing the lights, amazing displays (hard to believe the amount of money spent). Great tour would definitely recommend it!

This is the 2nd time seeing the Dyker Heights Lights. You haven't seen xmas lights till you have done Dyker Heights Xmas Lights. Did the ROW NYC tour - catching bus from Midtown, and traveling to first Bayridge, which has beautiful lights loved the house with only Blue lights, - stunning, 20 minutes to wander around, take photos, then back on the bus to Dyker - 40 minutes to do same - just amazing, the effort that goes into this, and the joy it brings.
Great place to take visitors from out of town - even people from town have never been before. A MUST DO.
Enoriqo our tour guide was very informative and added depth to the tour. friendly staff and an overall great experience

Antonia was great! I’m a New Yorker, but he shared facts about the city I did not know. It was also nice to hear a little history of the neighborhood. He took us to the best houses and make sure we had time to take pics. I would definitely recommend this experience.

We have been on other Dyker Street Christmas light tours. This one by far has been the BEST experience and would recommend. We made 3 different stops. Guide and bus driver were funny and informative. They made sure our safety came 1st. Bus was clean and fun. I will chose this tour again next visit. Loved it!

Overall a pleasant trip, the tour guide Milly was great and very knowledgeable
The houses were amazing and the coach journey was pleasant stopping at dumbo on the way back to catch some great pics of the city and Brooklyn bridge
A great trip which took us out of Manhatton. We were blown away by the decorated houses. The weather was not on our side but our guide made our trip very comfortable.
One of the best experiences our tour guide was great! Lots of walking, have storage for photo’s on your phone and have fun!!

The bus tour was great (but a long drive), the lights were amazing, the tour guide was charming, but the amount of people made it difficult to enjoy. We went on December 23rd, so maybe a trip earlier in December would be less crowded.
The guide was excellent and knowledgeable on and off the bus! The ice cream truck was special! The crowds of people was amazing
We loved this tour! Felt like you were walking in around in a movie, and the Brooklyn Bridge stop was great too! Definitely a must for all!!

It was nice to have been met right away at the meeting point. Allan, the tour guide was exceptionally knowledgable about NYC and gave an interesting and entertaining commentary throughout the tour. The tour was just the right length considering the crowds and temperature. We enjoyed the music, especially, New York, New York driving back into Manhatten. We would definitely recommend this tour.
We had Alan on our tour. He was very good and gave us a lot of good information about New York. We all really enjoyed the trip.

Excellent tour to Dyker Heights w/ Alan. It was a pleasant ride over and Alan was very knowledgeable. Learn things about the area before even leaving Manhattan. Lights were amazing and really added to our holiday trip. The stop under the Brooklyn bridge was an added bonus with a breathtaking view of the city. Great picture opportunity. Just dress for the weather it was about 20 degrees and there is walking involved.

We left promptly in a very comfortable coach. Antonio our guide was very informative and interesting on the drive to our first stop. You learn so much history on this tour it’s more than the lights. This was Bay Ridge. We spent about 20 mins here looking at the houses there was only one other bus. They were amazing but nothing compared to the houses at Dyker Heights.....wow. And it started to snow which made it extra special. Please see the green house and make a donation to help a young boy with a degenerative disease. Extremely well organised by the tour company and NYPD. Next stop the view of Manhattan and the Brooklyn Bridge so beautiful in the snow. Yes the ride back seems long, the whole trip took from 6pm to 10.15 but hey we are in NY. Well worth it!

Booked through american tours, really good tour guide made the trip a joy, the coach was a good size and included a toilet, the lights were fantastic if not a bit over the top but thats america for you, would highly recommend this tour very goid value for money and easy to book.

This tour was terrific. Never saw anything like these beautiful houses with that many decorations.
Don't miss it.
Absolutely amazing!! Would do it many more times! Our tour guide was the best and would recommend him

Great tour. Tons of information about NYC on the drive to Brooklyn. Lights were more than you can imagine. Then a stop at the waterfront for a spectacular view of the NYC skyline at night. Allen was our guide, took pictures for anyone who wanted them, gave amazing suggestions for dinner as well as giving us great information about the city present and past.
A brilliant Christmas tour with our guide Alan. Very informative for people from outside New York. Definitely recommend.
The wife and I had a wonderful time. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and took good care of everyone. The skyline view at the Brooklyn bridge was breathtaking.
Absolutely fabulous night, Edward our guide and Michael our driver were excellent , Manhattan skyline breathtaking

The tour was excellent it was amazing to see all the houses decorated we went on the 4th december but I would imagine the closer to christmas even more houses will be decorated, well worth a visit, have never seen so many lights.

Jorge our guide was fabulous! Not only did he give us a great tour he also gave us the history of the 5 boroughs I am from the area and I learned so much ! Jorge was very accommodating taking requests for holiday songs on the way back to Manhattan. He made the tour!

Let me start by saying that I live in Texas where there are many houses and few apartments. We have Christmas lights galore and I’ve grown up seeing them. By the reviews of this tour, I was expecting something magical but nope. 5 hour trip for just a few houses with lights. Met at 5pm. Dropped off after 10pm. Our tour guide was nice but that didn’t make up for 5 hr waste of our time.

Our tour guide missed the exit and we were delayed 30 minutes because of it. The lights in Dryker are nice but the time it took was just not worth seeing 10 nice houses. There were hundreds of other people on the street, the buses have a hard time navigating those small streets, and it just wasn’t enjoyable.
This is a great way to see Christmas outside of just Manhattan. I wanted to see more of New York than just the city. It can get crowded during the tour, but it is worth it.
